# SiroPHP

> Deterministic PHP API workflow with built-in debugging, request replay, and testing workflows. Minimal runtime dependencies.

SiroPHP lets you scaffold production-ready CRUD API modules in minutes (`make:crud`), understand production failures with captured execution context (`api:why` → `replay --diff`), and turn real traces into regression tests.

## Key facts

- Current Core version: v1.0.12
- Requires: PHP 8.2+, ext-pdo, ext-json, ext-mbstring
- License: MIT
- Cold boot: ~0.35 ms (Linux) / 2.4 ms (Windows, measured); ~370K route dispatches/sec; ~4 MB baseline RAM
- Tests: 21K+ Core tests executed; SiroPHP skeleton has 757 tests

- [Home](https://sirophp.com/): overview, benchmarks, install command
- [Install](https://sirophp.com/install): one-command installer for Windows/macOS/Linux
- [Docs](https://sirophp.com/docs): quick start and CLI reference
- [Documentation](https://sirophp.com/documentation): guides index, API reference index
- [Guides](https://sirophp.com/documentation/guides): auth, database, caching, queues, testing, deployment
- [API reference](https://sirophp.com/documentation/api): every class and method
- [Release notes](https://sirophp.com/documentation/release-notes): changelog per version
- [Benchmarks](https://sirophp.com/benchmarks): performance vs Laravel/Symfony
- [Blog](https://sirophp.com/blog): tutorials on debugging, replay, CLI testing
- [Security](https://sirophp.com/security): hardening defaults, DAST results
